purpose: Teach: 聖なる/僧侶/悲観/電化/断食/途方/悪徳/投影

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、聖なる儀礼の人類学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you covered the anthropology of sacred rituals in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. A teacher checking in, not testing. Gentle rise at the end, genuinely curious about her student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中世の僧侶教育を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on monastic education during the medieval period.
lines.style: Clear and direct, but with underlying care in the delivery. A student being honest about her work. Slightly formal register but genuine.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 悲観論と楽観論の比較を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the contrast between pessimistic and optimistic views in your research, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured pacing. A teacher reflecting on a student's intellectual approach with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、地方鉄道の電化史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the history of railway electrification in regional areas.
lines.style: Steady, precise delivery. A hint of focus, as if she's confirming her own research direction. No hesitation, fully committed to the answer.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 宗教的断食の効能を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also wrote about the effects of religious fasting in your paper, correct?
lines.style: Engaged and present. A teacher who has genuinely read the work and wants to draw it out. Warm curiosity underneath the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、孤独で途方に暮れる若者を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined young people struggling with loneliness and uncertainty.
lines.style: Calm but attentive. A student speaking about something that matters. The words land with quiet weight, not performative but genuine.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近世の悪徳商人を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered corrupt merchants in the early modern period in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective and measured. A teacher making sure she has the details right. Slight lift at the question mark, inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、影絵の投影技術史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the technological history of shadow puppet projection.
lines.style: Direct and clear, with a sense of closing something out. A student finishing her thought with quiet confidence. Slight breath at the end, like settling.
